`abstract class Shader`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IShader`](/reference/bridges/ishader/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlShader`](/reference/base-opengl/glshader/), [`VulkanShader`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanshader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Shader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/Shader.java)

The base class of a shader of a render bridge, which translates the two stages, lays out the uniforms and compiles the program at the first use.

## Description

The constructor compiles nothing: `compileProgram` runs at the first `isActive()`, once the fields of the subclass are set.
With the dev jar, a stage that uses a feature beyond GLSL 1.20 prints a warning.

## Creation details

<a id="Shader-constructor"></a>

### Shader

`Shader(RenderBridge bridge, GlslShaderTranslator translator, ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment, BlendState blend)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Builds the uniform block and the samplers of the two stages and translates them with the translator of your API.
Turns on the emulation of `CLAMP_TO_BORDER` when the bridge refuses that wrap.

<a id="Shader-method-sampler"></a>

### sampler

`IShader sampler(String name, ITexture texture, TextureFilter filter, TextureWrap wrap)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The shader declares no sampler …, declare it in the shader source or fix its name (samplers: …)

Sets the texture of a sampler, with its filter and wrap.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` that lists the samplers when the shader declares no sampler of that name.

Return `true` when the program compiled and links.

<a id="Shader-method-compileProgram"></a>

### compileProgram

`void compileProgram(ShaderTranslation translation)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it once, at the first `isActive()`.
Compile and link the translated sources; on failure, print one warning that starts with `[JOID]` and leave the program inactive, without throwing.
